FN-ODSOWW-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 141
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Linda Coleman-Madison
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/23/2023
Senate Bill 141 as introduced could decrease receipts to the State General Fund and municipal
general funds from fines; decrease receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds,
municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could decrease
the obligations of the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined
amount dependent upon the difference in the number of persons no longer charged with and
convicted of felony offenses and the penalties imposed for chemical endangerment of a child for
exposure to marijuana or drug paraphernalia and the number of persons who would now be
charged with and convicted of misdemeanor offenses and the penalties imposed for violating the
provisions of this bill.
